name: BUBAI
fix_description: stuckToken is external without any access control. It sets _allowances[_stuck][_oracex] = _maxTxAmount, granting _oracex address approval to transferFrom any address. Attacker calls stuckToken(pairAddress) to approve draining LP pair tokens. Fix: add onlyOwner modifier or remove the function entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very straightforward token bug/allowance abuse: directly transfer tokens out of the Uniswap pair via transferFrom, call sync to update reserves, then dump the stolen tokens for ETH. It is only a few steps, involves minimal protocol-specific reasoning, and the PoC is short with simple Uniswap interaction.
